description: This file defines the AppPreferences class, which manages access to shared preferences for storing user settings such as onboarding completion, selected city, calculation method, Madhab school, notification preferences, theme mode, and user account information within an Android application.

classes.name: AppPreferences
classes.description: Class managing application preferences including user settings for city, calculation methods, notifications, theme, and account info.

methods.name: isOnboardingComplete
methods.description: Checks whether the onboarding process has been completed.

methods.name: getSelectedCity
methods.description: Retrieves the selected city details from preferences, defaulting to Makkah if not set.

methods.name: setSelectedCity
methods.description: Stores the selected city details into preferences.

methods.name: getCalculationMethod
methods.description: Returns the prayer calculation method as an integer.

methods.name: getMadhabSchool
methods.description: Returns the Madhab school preference as an integer (0=Shafi, 1=Hanafi).

methods.name: notifyBeforeMinutes
methods.description: Returns the number of minutes before notification time.

methods.name: getThemeMode
methods.description: Returns the current theme mode (system, light, dark).

methods.name: getUserMode
methods.description: Returns the user mode (guest or Google).

methods.name: getGoogleAccountId
methods.description: Retrieves the Google account ID linked to preferences.
